title: fix: display error message when WhatsApp message fetch fails
body: ## Summary Fixes a bug where the WhatsApp chat component showed "No messages yet" instead of the actual error when message fetching failed after conversations loaded successfully. Now properly displays the error message in red when the API call to fetch messages fails. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Verify error state displays correctly by temporarily breaking the API key or network ### Notes Follow-up to #16 addressing Devin Review feedback. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/6fdf3a6e5a9d4612ad4a9123fbeaa62c Requested by: @botirk38 ---
